article_content: Ryan Giggs has received a lifetime achievement award, but his future in football remains uncertain. As Manchester United's interim player-coach, Giggs will decide his next step after the club's final game against Southampton. The potential appointment of Louis van Gaal as the new manager may influence Giggs' decision. 'My priority is preparing the team for the game against Southampton,' Giggs said. 'After the season, I'll consider my options.' With a record 13 league titles, Giggs is the most decorated player in Premier League history.

article_content: A powerful storm moved across the US this week, resulting in rain, snow, and at least four fatalities. The storm's impact stretched from Canada to the Gulf of Mexico, bringing significant weather conditions to various regions. In the north-central and northeastern US, heavy snowfall occurred, while the Ohio and Mississippi valleys experienced torrential rain. Additionally, tornadoes were reported in the Deep South. Four individuals lost their lives in separate incidents in Missouri, Mississippi, and Nebraska. A woman succumbed to hypothermia after her vehicle broke down near Berea, Nebraska, during a blizzard. Her son survived but suffered from frostbite and hypothermia. An employee of Ameren Missouri was electrocuted while attempting to restore power following the storms. In Mississippi, one person died when a tornado destroyed a steel building along a highway in Kemper County. A 34-year-old woman from Oxford, Mississippi, lost her life when her vehicle hydroplaned and overturned. Another five people were injured in the storms across Mississippi.
